patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layouts are frequently used, pairing explanatory text or code snippets with a larger visual demonstration or screenshot on the opposing side.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for impact, contrasted with a distinct monospace font for all code examples.
The site employs a high-contrast, minimal color palette dominated by white backgrounds, dark text, and a vibrant sky blue for accents and calls to action.
Content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and a slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, guided scrolling experience.
Dedicated sections showcase a dense grid of partner logos and a diverse, masonry-like gallery of websites built using the product, serving as social proof and inspiration.

technique_notes: Implement a scroll-triggered animation system, likely using `locomotive-scroll` as hinted, to reveal content sections with a subtle fade and upward slide as they enter the viewport.
Utilize a fixed header that remains visible at the top of the page, providing persistent navigation and branding.
Design content blocks with a clear visual distinction between code examples (dark background, monospace font, syntax highlighting) and their corresponding visual output or explanatory text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body size) paired with smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels and clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on most interactive elements and content blocks, with slightly more pronounced rounding on some UI examples and code blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in hero and main content sections, providing ample breathing room, with a notably tighter grid for partner logos.

standout: The site's design is a direct embodiment of the product it sells, showcasing the clean, utility-first aesthetic of Tailwind CSS through its own structure and presentation. The seamless integration of live code snippets alongside their visual output makes the design itself a powerful and highly effective demonstration of the framework's capabilities.
